```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml)

# ---- Helpers ----

# Assign emoji + category based on playbook name
get_playbook_meta <- function(name) {
    mapping <- list(
        "r-init-" = c("🚀", "Scaffolding"),
        "r-lint" = c("🧹", "Code Quality"),
        "r-tdd-" = c("🧪", "Testing"),
        "r-bdd-" = c("🥒", "Testing"),
        "r-testthat-" = c("📸", "Testing"),
        "r-shiny-module" = c("🧩", "Shiny"),
        "r-shiny-theme-" = c("🎨", "Shiny"),
        "r-shiny-e2e-" = c("🔍", "Shiny"),
        "r-docker-" = c("🐳", "DevOps"),
        "r-ci-" = c("🔄", "DevOps"),
        "r-pkg-check" = c("✅", "Packages"),
        "r-pkg-add-" = c("➕", "Packages"),
        "r-pkg-release" = c("🏷️", "Packages"),
        "r-pkgcheck-" = c("🔎", "Packages"),
        "r-pkgdown-" = c("📖", "Packages"),
        "r-pak-" = c("🔐", "Packages"),
        "r-security" = c("🔒", "Security"),
        "r-connect-" = c("☁️", "Deployment"),
        "r-vetiver-" = c("🏺", "Deployment"),
        "r-config-" = c("⚙️", "Configuration"),
        "r-logger-" = c("📋", "Observability"),
        "r-otel-" = c("📊", "Observability"),
        "r-profile" = c("⚡", "Performance"),
        "r-refactor" = c("🔧", "Maintenance"),
        "r-quarto-" = c("📄", "Reporting"),
        "r-data-" = c("📊", "Data"),
        "r-targets-" = c("🎯", "Pipelines"),
        "r-box-" = c("📁", "Modules"),
        "r-rhino-" = c("🦏", "Apps"),
        "r-s7-" = c("🏗️", "OOP"),
        "r-async-" = c("⏳", "Async"),
        "r-api-" = c("🔌", "API"),
        "r-code-review" = c("👀", "Review"),
        "r-pointblank-" = c("🛡️", "Validation"),
        "r-r-version" = c("📌", "Configuration")
    )

    for (prefix in names(mapping)) {
        if (startsWith(name, prefix)) {
            return(mapping[[prefix]])
        }
    }
    c("📋", "Other")
}

# ---- Read all playbooks ----

playbook_dirs <- list.dirs("playbooks", recursive = FALSE)
playbooks <- list()

for (dir in playbook_dirs) {
    md_file <- file.path(dir, "PLAYBOOK.md")
    if (!file.exists(md_file)) {
        next
    }

    content <- readLines(md_file, warn = FALSE)
    dashes <- which(content == "---")
    if (length(dashes) < 2) {
        next
    }

    yaml_text <- paste(
        content[(dashes[1] + 1):(dashes[2] - 1)],
        collapse = "\n"
    )
    meta <- tryCatch(yaml.load(yaml_text), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(meta)) {
        next
    }

    m <- get_playbook_meta(meta$name)

    playbooks[[length(playbooks) + 1]] <- list(
        name = meta$name,
        desc = meta$description %||% "",
        version = meta$version %||% "1.0.0",
        trigger = meta$trigger %||% "manual",
        dir = basename(dir),
        icon = m[1],
        category = m[2],
        gh_url = sprintf(
            "https://github.com/davidrsch/r-playbooks/blob/main/playbooks/%s/PLAYBOOK.md",
            basename(dir)
        )
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

n_total <- length(playbooks)
cats <- sort(table(sapply(playbooks, `[[`, "category")), decreasing = TRUE)
```

::: {.playbook-grid id="playbook-grid"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cards <- character(length(playbooks))
for (i in seq_along(playbooks)) {
    pb <- playbooks[[i]]
    trigger_class <- if (pb$trigger == "both") "both" else "manual"
    trigger_label <- toupper(pb$trigger)

    cards[i] <- sprintf(
        '<a href="%s" class="playbook-card" data-name="%s" data-category="%s" style="--card-accent: var(--bs-primary);"><div class="card-header"><span class="card-icon">%s</span><span class="card-name">%s</span></div><div class="card-description">%s</div><div class="card-meta"><span class="badge badge-version">v%s</span><span class="badge badge-trigger %s">%s</span></div></a>',
        pb$gh_url,
        pb$name,
        pb$category,
        pb$icon,
        pb$name,
        pb$desc,
        pb$version,
        trigger_class,
        trigger_label
    )
}

knitr::asis_output(paste(cards, collapse = "\n"))
```
